visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman in a purple fleece jacket lies on a grey sofa, yawning deeply. She uses a long yellow mop handle to reach for a light switch on the wall but fails, falling off the sofa. (2) She is seen crawling on the floor wrapped in an orange blanket towards the switch. She eventually stands up and toggles the switch manually in a dim room. (3) The scene cuts to her sitting at a table in a bright living room, holding a product box for a smart switch gadget. (4) Close-ups show white mechanical arms and a black remote control. She operates the remote, causing the small white arm on the device to move. (5) She moves to an office hallway, where the device is mounted on a large light switch. She presses the remote, and the switch flips off. (6) She tests the device in a kitchen area where another person is sitting. She accidentally turns the lights off on them, leading to a comedic reaction shot. (7) Finally, she is in a bedroom/office setting, using the remote to turn off a computer monitor. She strikes a confident pose as the screen goes black.
